text: The same enzyme that splits lactose into glucose and galactose also, at high lactose concentration, hooks the galactose onto other sugars instead of water. The result is a mix of short galactose chains with a glucose at the end. Yield depends on enzyme, lactose concentration and how far the reaction is run.
